title: At the Cross
lyrics: [C]Alas, and did my Savior bleed? And [F]did [C]my [G7]Sovereign [G]die?
[C]At the cross, at the cross [F]where [C]I [G7]first saw the light,
[G7]And the burden of my heart rolled [C]away,
It was [F]there by faith I [C]received my sight,
[D]Alas, and did my saviour bleed, and [G]did [D]my [G]Sovereign [A7]die?
Would [D]He devote that sacred head, for [A7]sinners such as [D]I?
At the [D]cross, at the cross, Where I [A7]first saw the light.
And the [G]burden of my heart rolled [D]away.
[D7]It was [G]there by faith I [D]received my sight,
And [A7]now I am happy all the [D]day.
[D]Was it for crimes that I have done, He [G]suffered on [D]the [A7]tree?
[D]But drops of grief can ne'er repay, the [G]debt [D]of [G]love [D]I [A7]owe.
Here, [D]Lord I give myself away. 'Tis [A7]all that I can [D]do.
